text:
maria: hmm the gha eval runner flapped during the nightly smoke, PR gating showed "job queued" for 12m then failed
kevin: logs?
sasha: saw this too, runner heartbeat lost on self-hosted hosts :grimacing:
ci-bot: [alert] workflow 'evals/pr-gate' retry triggered by runner-unstable
maria: paste of last 5 lines:
```
2026-02-28T03:14:07Z runner: heartbeat missed (1/3)
2026-02-28T03:14:18Z runner: job requeued job=evals/pr-gate shard=12
2026-02-28T03:14:18Z runner: starting job
2026-02-28T03:14:30Z runner: heartbeat missed (2/3)
2026-02-28T03:14:42Z job: failed due to runner disconnect
```
kevin: looks like the scheduler is re-assigning, causing duplicate job runs for the same PR -> artifact collisions
sasha: possible root causes: kernel OOM, ipmi power cycle, or our systemd watchdog killing container. I have a repro on a dev host.
tim: can we short-circuit reruns with `concurrency: evals-pr-${{ github.ref }}` or `if: github.event_name != 'schedule'`?
maria: also happening when cron overlaps with PR-triggered jobs (nightly cron starts same workflow)
oncall-ml: temporary mitigation: disable nightly schedule for evals/pr-gate until we fix
kevin: longer term: add job-level dedupe by gating on a run-level artifact lock; or use `workflow_run` to fanout only from cron
sasha: I'll open a tiny PR to add `concurrency: group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}` and `cancel-in-progress: true` and add heartbeat metrics to runner exporter
maria: +1, also add a tag to self-hosted runners to prefer stable nodes
tim: fyi adding jitter to cron (randomized minutes) helps reduce overlap, but doesn't fix runner disconnects
ci-bot: created issue #3421: gha-selfhosted-heartbeat-flap - assigned sasha
maria: cool, thanks. will keep the nightly disabled till monday :thumbsup:
kevin: if anyone sees flapping on buildkite for eval shards call me
sasha: working on repro steps, will post soon with systemd logs and kernel dmesg
maria: thanks, keeping this thread updated :eyes:
